mapper.sql: FROM strategy_case strategy_case JOIN sku ON sku.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id JOIN product ON product.product_id = sku.product_id LEFT JOIN category ON category.category_id = product.category_id LEFT JOIN category parent_category ON parent_category.category_id = category.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN category grandparent_category ON grandparent_category.category_id = parent_category.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = strategy_case.created_by
mapper.select:
SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.case_status, strategy_case.generation_stage, strategy_case.recommendation_outcome, sku.sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, product.image_url, category.category_id, category.category_name, category.category_level, parent_category.category_name AS parent_category_name, grandparent_category.category_name AS grandparent_category_name, requester.user_id AS requester_id, requester.user_name AS requester_name, strategy_case.created_at, strategy_case.completed_at, strategy_case.result_expires_at, strategy_case.failure_code, strategy_case.failure_message
ORDER BY
strategy_case.created_at ASC, strategy_case.strategy_case_id ASC
strategy_case.created_at DESC, strategy_case.strategy_case_id DESC
OFFSET #{query.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{query.size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT strategy_case.case_status, COUNT(*) AS status_count
GROUP BY strategy_case.case_status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse WHERE warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0
